name: patient_id
description: Synthea patient id (synthetic).

name: encounter_id
description: Synthea encounter id of the index inpatient stay (synthetic); unique.

name: index_start
description: Start (admission) of the index stay, UTC.

name: index_stop
description: End (discharge) of the index stay, UTC; the partition column (MONTH).

name: is_readmitted
description: Label: 1 if an unplanned readmission starts within 30 days after index_stop (unplanned_readmission_v1), else 0.

name: label_horizon
description: Latest record the label depends on, UTC (the split's label-horizon purge reads it).

name: admission_reason_code
description: SNOMED-CT reason code of the index stay; NULL when Synthea records none.

name: admission_reason_description
description: Description of admission_reason_code; NULL when Synthea records none.

name: payer_ownership
description: Ownership of the index stay's payer.

name: provider_specialty
description: Specialty of the index stay's provider (constant on Synthea data; excluded from the features).

name: organization_utilization
description: Whole-simulation utilization of the organization (not point-in-time; excluded from the features).

name: prior_encounter_count
description: Encounters of the patient in the lookback window before index_start.

name: prior_inpatient_count
description: Inpatient encounters in the lookback window before index_start.

name: prior_emergency_count
description: Emergency encounters in the lookback window before index_start.

name: active_condition_count
description: Conditions active at index_start.

name: active_medication_count
description: Medications active at index_start.

name: procedure_count_window
description: Procedures in the lookback window before index_start.

name: active_careplan_count
description: Care plans active at index_start.

name: observation_count_window
description: Observations in the lookback window before index_start.

name: age_at_index_years
description: Age in years at index_start.

name: gender
description: Synthea gender (synthetic).

name: race
description: Synthea race (synthetic).

name: ethnicity
description: Synthea ethnicity (synthetic).

name: marital_status
description: Synthea marital status (synthetic); NULL when Synthea records none.
